info.name: HubSpot Integration Microservice
info.description: Local REST endpoints for the HubSpot Contacts integration service (OAuth install/callback, sync, read, webhook). Matches the curl examples in README.md.

item.name: Auth - Install (redirect to HubSpot consent screen)

request.description: Redirects the browser to HubSpot's OAuth consent screen. Best opened directly in a browser rather than sent from Postman, since completing the flow requires clicking Allow.

query.description: One-time authorization code from HubSpot's redirect after clicking Allow

request.description: Exchanges the authorization code for access/refresh tokens and stores them. HubSpot codes are single-use and short-lived, so this only works right after a real /auth/install redirect completes.

Triggers a full paginated pull of all Contacts from HubSpot into the local DB. Idempotent, safe to send repeatedly. Also reconciles deletions: any local contact no longer in HubSpot's full list is removed, but only after a fully successful pull.
Lists locally synced contacts. Query params: limit (1-100, default 20), after (local id cursor), sort (id_asc | id_desc), email (exact match filter).

Pushes a local edit to HubSpot (last-write-wins by comparing HubSpot's lastmodifieddate against the local row's updated_at), then refreshes the local row from HubSpot's response. :id is the local autoincrement id from GET /contacts, not the HubSpot contact ID. Body accepts any subset of email, first_name, last_name, lifecycle_stage.

response.name: 200 OK (real push against a HubSpot test account)
409 stale_write_conflict
response.body: {"error":"stale_write_conflict","message":"HubSpot has a newer version of this contact than the one this edit was based on. Re-sync (GET /contacts or POST /sync/contacts) and retry.","hubspotLastModified":"2026-08-27T19:52:47.843Z"}

request.description: This is HubSpot's legacy webhook payload shape (subscriptionType/objectId/eventId). A manual request like this will always get 401, signature verification requires HubSpot's real HMAC over X-HubSpot-Signature-v3 / X-HubSpot-Request-Timestamp, which only HubSpot's servers can produce with the app's client secret. This request exists to document the payload shape and prove the endpoint correctly rejects unsigned traffic. A contact.deletion event uses the same shape with no propertyName/propertyValue, and removes the local row instead of refetching.
